(3) The female voice continues with a bright tone, accompanied by soft street ambience including the faint hum of a motor. (4) A loud, sudden bus engine roar and a short beep of a horn mark a transition to the road-crossing phase. (5) The female voice changes to a repulsed, slightly gagging tone while describing stinky tofu. (6) A crisp, percussive slicing sound effect occurs as the apple is cut in the studio. (7) A deep, professional male narrator's voice joins the female speaker, providing informational details about the apples with a steady, authoritative pitch. (8) A loud crunching sound of a fresh bite is heard clearly over the music. (9) The audio concludes with a humorous, loud post-production burp sound effect after the female speaker finishes her line, followed by a final upbeat musical flourish.
